verdict.rationale: Render's docs list Docker support as a first-party capability of its deployment platform, and a community user independently praises its 'great docker support', so deploying Docker-packaged applications is directly supported. The first-party evidence is only a docs section title, so the details are thin. Missing for 10: detailed docs on Dockerfile builds versus deploying prebuilt images from a registry, private registry authentication, and hands-on deploy walkthroughs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy applications packaged as Docker containers

citations.quote: In addition to great docker support and free static sites
Render (https://render.com) is a cloud application platform for deploying, securing, and scaling applications
